proposal.summary: File upload vulnerability in DWSurvey DWSurvey-OSS v.3.2.0 and earlier that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the saveimage method and savveFile in action/UploadAction.java.
proposal.cwe_quote: File Upload vulnerability in DWSurvey DWSurvey-OSS v.3.2.0 and before allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the saveimage method and savveFile in the action/UploadAction.java file.
proposal.recommended_next_step: Attempt to reproduce the issue by exercising the saveimage and savveFile upload endpoints to upload a crafted file; capture proof-of-concept, request vulnerable application logs/stack traces, and identify the code path in action/UploadAction.java. If confirmed, advise immediate mitigations (disable file uploads or restrict upload directory and execution permissions) and develop a patch to validate and restrict uploaded file types and storage location.
